game.name: Doot Games
game.author: Doot Games project (MIT); L33TEST Crossroads integration
game.description: A live, collaborative party-game platform. Host puts a game on the big screen, everyone else joins from their phone with a short room code or QR -- no accounts needed to play. The full canonical catalog: Story Chain, Mad Libs, Doodle Chain, Quip Clash, Split the Room, Wavelength, and dozens more.
